user.title: Connection
user.description: Enter the IP address and port of your Ovum MIRA heat pump.

license.title: License Level
license.description: Select the Modbus access level you have purchased from Ovum. Level 1 (Start Values) is free. Level 2 (Plus Values) and Level 3 (BMS Values) require a paid license from Ovum.

ww_type.title: Domestic Hot Water
ww_type.description: Select 'Internal fresh water station' if your MIRA has a built-in Frischwasserstation. Most external tank installations should leave this unchecked.

hk_count.title: Heating Circuits & WPM Modules
hk_count.description: Enter the number of heating circuits (HK) and WPM (heat pump module) units installed. Level 1 supports HK1-2; Level 2+ supports HK3-4.

cooling.title: Cooling
cooling.description: Enable if your MIRA is configured for active cooling.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to MIRA. Check IP address and port.
error.login_failed: Connected but Modbus login failed. Verify your Modbus cable and access level.

abort.already_configured: This MIRA device is already configured.
